Message:
drm/i915: Push TRANS_DDI_FUNC_CTL into the encoder->enable() hook

Push the TRANS_DDI_FUNC_CTL into the encoder enable hook. The disable
is already there, and as a followup will enable us to pass the encoder
all the way down.
